notes: The substance whose crystal forms are the subject of the study. role is other because nothing is synthesised and no bond is made or broken: the section reports solid-state conversions between modifications of one molecule suspended in a methanol and water mixture. No quantity is stated.
Component of the suspension medium, stated as volume ratio methanol:water 1:9. The ratio is a condition and not a quantity of either component, so quantity is null.
Component of the suspension medium, stated as volume ratio methanol:water 1:9 and therefore the major component. The ratio is a condition and not a quantity of either component, so quantity is null.

Same molecule as tembotrione, differing only in the crystal lattice; it is not a distinct chemical entity but the same active substance in another modification. This is form A. In this study a mixture of forms A, B and C had converted into form A after 2 days, and the pure modification A was unchanged after 8 days, so form A is both a starting form and the end form of the conversion; role product records it as the form the conversion produces.

Same molecule as tembotrione, differing only in the crystal lattice; it is not a distinct chemical entity but the same active substance in another modification. This is form B. Form B is the modification the patent excludes as not according to the invention. role is reactant because form B is the form consumed: after 3 days modification B had converted completely into modification C, and form B is also a component of the mixture of forms A, B and C that converted into form A. CONTRADICTION RECORDED, NOT RESOLVED: the two outcomes stated for B differ, a mixture containing B going to A while pure B goes to C, in the same medium over the same temperature range.

Same molecule as tembotrione, differing only in the crystal lattice; it is not a distinct chemical entity but the same active substance in another modification. This is form C. The pure modification C was unchanged after 8 days and modification B had converted completely into modification C after 3 days, so C appears both as a starting form and as a product; it is also a component of the mixture of forms A, B and C that converted into form A.
